name: codeapi-adapter
description: Internal manifest for the CODEAPI JS adapter (the code behind the ROOT package.json's main). Launches and supervises the Python CODEAPI runtime and bridges irreducible vscode.* operations. Not a standalone extension: contributions, version, and activation live in the root manifest.

dependencies.//: node-pty 1.1.0 (N-API, ABI-stable) — matches the repo root node_modules/node-pty. Required by the /vscode/term/* bridge and the /exec `nodePty`/`codeApiTerm` globals. Pinned exact to the proven-loadable prebuild.
